presentation.label: TRACK NAMES
presentation.summary: The Internal Mixer shows each track's own name instead of TRK1..TRK16, with the track number above every fader.
presentation.overview: Track Names puts the names you give tracks in SETUP > RENAME on the Internal Mixer: the first 5 characters replace TRK1..TRK16, and each fader gets its track number in an inverted box at its top left. The names are the Digitakt II's own track names, kept in each pattern's kit, so every pattern has its own and they are saved with the project. The mod only draws; it saves nothing.
highlights: Your track names on mixer pages 2/5 and 3/5, first 5 characters
Per pattern and saved with the project, by the stock names themselves
Pop-ups such as pattern select stay on top
usage: Select a track with TRK + its trig, open SETUP with FUNC + FLTR and scroll down to RENAME, the last row of the TRACK section.
Press YES, enter a short name with UP/DOWN and LEFT/RIGHT (FUNC + NO deletes) and press YES to save it.
Open FUNC + MOD, then press FUNC + MOD again for Internal Mixer 2/5 (tracks 1-8); once more for 3/5 (tracks 9-16).
Each fader shows its track number at the top left and the first 5 characters of its name below; a track still named PRESET n keeps TRKn.

access.location: Name tracks in SETUP (FUNC + FLTR) > RENAME; the names show on FUNC + MOD, Internal Mixer pages 2/5 and 3/5.
steps: Select a track with TRK + its trig, open SETUP with FUNC + FLTR and scroll down to RENAME, the last row of the TRACK section.
Press YES, enter a short name with UP/DOWN and LEFT/RIGHT (FUNC + NO deletes) and press YES to save it.
Open FUNC + MOD, then press FUNC + MOD again for Internal Mixer 2/5 (tracks 1-8); once more for 3/5 (tracks 9-16).

limitations: Only Internal Mixer pages 2/5 and 3/5 show names; other pages are unchanged.
The mixer shows the first 5 characters of a name.
A track whose name is still PRESET n keeps its stock TRK label.
With PERFORM KIT on, the names shown are those of the pattern you are on (not tested).

load.display: UI task only, on the mixer pages: under about 2% of the CPU; elsewhere a few dozen instructions a frame
load.conditions: Static count from the -O2 ColdFire code: every page reads at most 52 scroll-bar pixels and stops there, except Internal Mixer 2/5 and 3/5. There a frame checks the MIX box (about 400 pixels), reads up to 6,912 pixels to find a pop-up, renders up to 16 TRKn labels into a scratch frame with the OS's text routine to compare, and draws 8 badges and up to 8 names: at most about 200,000 instructions, 30 frames a second, UI task only. No audio-path code.

hardware.summary: crisp909 (the author) built 0.1.3 with the pinned toolchain in Docker (source commit c22d81d, package sha256 51053686), built the image on elekloader.github.io with core 1.0 and ran it on a Digitakt II, OS 1.17. Reported: names and numbered badges on Internal Mixer 2/5 and 3/5; each pattern its own names with PERFORM KIT off; names back after SAVE PROJECT and a reload; other pages unchanged; the pattern select pop-up stays on top. About 2 hours of testing in all (0.1.2 and 0.1.3).
limitations: PERFORM KIT on was not tested.
Faint row lines beside pop-ups are the OLED's own crosstalk, seen with the stock OS too.

tests.summary: crisp909 (the author) ran the pinned-toolchain 0.1.3 package (sha256 51053686…) on a Digitakt II, OS 1.17, core 1.0, about 2 hours in all: names on mixer pages 2/5 and 3/5, per pattern with PERFORM KIT off, kept after SAVE PROJECT and a reload, other pages unchanged, pop-ups on top. Emulator checks and screenshots in TESTING.md and media/capture.json.
